task.title: Plan monitoring inputs, backup evidence, and update windows
task.shortdesc: Prepare current-state operational evidence for a source-run instance while avoiding claims about managed monitoring, official restore automation, or rolling upgrades.

prereq.p: The instance has passed source readiness and network exposure review, and a single administrator or DevOps owner is responsible for the evaluation window.

context.p: Until distributions and runtime service decisions exist, operations planning should focus on observable inputs, manual backup and export evidence, and explicit update windows for one source node.

step.cmd: List the monitoring inputs that exist today.

info.p: Record process status, foreground terminal output, stdout, stderr, GET /health, GET /health/ready, selected API example results, documentation access through /help/, and the source revision from git rev-parse --short HEAD.

step.cmd: Collect backup and export evidence before the window.

info.codeblock: mkdir -p backups cp data/bpm.db backups/bpm-pre-update.db sha256sum backups/bpm-pre-update.db
info.p: Also export representative Firefox documents such as GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/export/profiles/42/firefox/policies.json and store the resulting policies.json evidence with checksums.

step.cmd: Schedule a stop-the-world update window for source changes.

info.p: For 0.9.0, plan one-node downtime before git fetch --tags, dependency refresh, alembic upgrade head, make docs-validate, and make docs-build. Rolling upgrades are planned but not implemented yet.

step.cmd: Record gaps as blockers, not hidden assumptions.

info.note: BPM 0.9.0 does not provide managed monitoring, automated backup scheduling, official restore automation, point-in-time recovery, managed secrets, token rotation, or rolling upgrade orchestration. Use manual evidence and stop conditions from the update runbook.

result.p: The operation plan contains monitoring inputs, backup/export evidence, and a realistic update window for current source operation.

postreq.p: Attach this evidence to the HA and deferred-boundary record so later distribution work can reuse the same checklist.
